python - <<'PY'
from boltons.iterutils import remap, research, split, split_iter

for source in ([1, None, 2], (1, None, 2), iter([1, None, 2]), 'abc'):
    expected = list(source)
    assert split(iter(expected), maxsplit=0) == [expected]
    assert list(split_iter(iter(expected), maxsplit=0)) == [expected]
assert split([], maxsplit=0) == [[]]
source = [1, 2]
result = split(source, maxsplit=0)
assert result == [source] and result[0] is not source

root = []
root.append(root)
cache = {}
mapped = remap(root, cache=cache)
assert mapped is mapped[0]
assert cache[id(root)] is mapped
assert remap(root, cache=cache) is mapped

shared = {'value': 1}
root = [shared, shared]
cache = {}
entered = []
from boltons.iterutils import default_enter
def enter(p, k, v):
    entered.append(id(v))
    return default_enter(p, k, v)
mapped = remap(root, enter=enter, cache=cache)
assert mapped[0] is mapped[1]
assert entered.count(id(shared)) == 1
assert remap([shared], cache=cache)[0] is mapped[0]

root = {}
root['self'] = root
root['value'] = 1
cache = {}
assert research(root, query=lambda p, k, v: isinstance(v, int), cache=cache) == [(('value',), 1)]
assert id(root) in cache
assert research(root, cache=cache) == []
assert research(root, query=lambda p, k, v: isinstance(v, int)) == [(('value',), 1)]
print('Cache, cycle, shared-reference, and zero-split checks passed.')
PY
